title: 3 Indian AI startups jinhone October mein funding uthayi - Hunar, Karta, CurvetAI
content:
Ek startup jo 1 saal se bhi kam purana hai, aur uske 1 LAKH MONTHLY USERS hain. Aur ye India se hai.
Aaj main aapko 3 Indian AI startups dikhata hoon jinhone isi October funding uthayi.
All 3 are solving very different problems. But there is ONE PATTERN that connects all 3.
Last mein wo pattern bataunga, kyunki wahi asli lesson hai.
Startup number 1, Hunar.AI.
Inhone Blume Ventures ki lead mein 40 crore rupaye ka Series A raise kiya. Total funding ab 65 crore hai.
Founders hain Krishna Khandelwal aur Shantanu Bhattacharyya.
They build AI agents for hiring frontline workers. These agents talk to candidates on voice calls and WhatsApp.
Screening, interview scheduling, onboarding, all of it.
Company ke hisaab se, September 2026 mein inke agents ne 15 MILLION se zyada conversations handle ki.
Aur ye 20 se zyada languages support karte hain, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada bhi.
Their clients include Swiggy, Delhivery and Flipkart.
Ab doosra startup, aur ye banking ka game hai.
Startup number 2, Karta AI, Bengaluru se.
Inhone 3 million dollar ka seed round raise kiya, lagbhag 28 crore rupaye, PeerCapital aur Cedar Hill Capital ki lead mein.
Ye voice AI agents banate hain jo banks, lenders, fintech aur insurance companies ke inbound customer calls handle karte hain.
Founders Vijaypal Singh aur Abhishek Kushwaha dono PEHLE RAZORPAY MEIN the, aur wahan internal AI automation pe kaam kar chuke the.
They solved the problem inside a company first, then turned it into a product.
Startup number 3, CurvetAI, Pune se.
Founded December 2025 mein, Vivek Dubey aur Utkarsh Gupta ne.
It is an AI workspace that puts many AI tools in one place.
Inhone Merak Ventures ki lead mein 6 crore ka pre-seed uthaya, aur company kehti hai ki 1 lakh se zyada monthly users hain, aur revenue bhi shuru ho chuka hai.
Ab pattern suno.
Teeno ne koi naya foundation model nahi banaya.
They picked one boring, painful workflow and put AI agents on top of it.
Hiring calls, bank calls, and switching between tools.
Mera take simple hai.
India mein agla bada AI startup shayad model nahi, EK WORKFLOW HOGA.
Agar aap kisi company mein kaam karte ho, toh dekho kaunsa kaam roz repeat hota hai. Wahi aapka startup idea ho sakta hai.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
